state.task: Move every block except the red block into one bin. Destination: the left bin.

destination.controls: which bin the blocks go into

values.slow: half speed; for when the user wants the arm slower or more careful

skip.controls: a one-off: set aside the block the arm is going for right now and do it last

values.current_target: set aside the block the arm is currently going for (do it last) and start on another block

instructions.question: What is the user's new message (`utterance.text`) asking the robot to do, given what it is doing now (`task`, `status`)?

criteria.adjust: Change a setting of the current task: one of the knobs in `knobs` (e.g. the order, the speed, the bin, or setting aside the block the arm is going for)
criteria.stop: Stop the task now and stay stopped
criteria.pause: Wait for a moment, then carry on with the same task (e.g. 'hold on', 'one sec')
criteria.resume: Carry on after a pause (e.g. 'ok, go on')
criteria.new_task: Drop this task and do something different that the knobs cannot express
criteria.continue: Carry on exactly as before; confirms or praises what the arm is doing (e.g. 'keep going', 'looks good')
criteria.not_for_me: Not addressed to the robot, or not an instruction at all

instructions.question: After the user's new message (`utterance.text`), what should the knob `destination` (which bin the blocks go into) be? It is `left` now.

criteria.unchanged: the message does not ask to change this

instructions.question: After the user's new message (`utterance.text`), what should the knob `pace` (how fast the arm moves) be? It is `normal` now.

criteria.slow: half speed; for when the user wants the arm slower or more careful
criteria.unchanged: the message does not ask to change this

instructions.question: After the user's new message (`utterance.text`), what should the knob `skip` (a one-off: set aside the block the arm is going for right now and do it last) be? It is `none` now.

criteria.current_target: set aside the block the arm is currently going for (do it last) and start on another block
criteria.unchanged: the message does not ask to change this

instructions.question: If the user's new message (`utterance.text`) changes anything, when should the change take effect?

criteria.now: right away, even in the middle of the current move

instructions.question: Can the user's new message (`utterance.text`) be handled with the knobs listed in `knobs` and the intents offered, without a smarter model re-planning the task?

criteria.decide_now: yes: the answer can be read directly off the state and the options offered
criteria.ask_a_smarter_model: no: it is unclear, contradictory, refers to something not in the state, or needs several reasoning steps not already done in the state
